{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the correct column for new customers
print("Unique values in 'customer_segment':")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check if the data has a 'new' segment
new_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new']
print(f"Number of new customers: {len(new_customers)}")

# Check the 'channel' column
print("\nUnique values in 'channel':")
print(sales_df['channel'].unique())

# Check for 'paid_search' in channel
paid_search = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']
print(f"Number of paid_search rows: {len(paid_search)}")

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]
print(f"Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {len(filtered_df)}")

# Check how many of them converted
converted_new_paid_search = filtered_df[filtered_df['converted'] == 1]
print(f"Number of conversions among NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {len(converted_new_paid_search)}")"}
